objects.name: trg_products_fts_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON products BEGIN DELETE FROM products_fts WHERE id = old.id; END

objects.name: trg_products_fts_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON products BEGIN INSERT INTO products_fts (id, title, brand, sku, barcode, category) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.brand, new.sku, new.barcode, new.category); END

objects.name: trg_products_fts_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON products BEGIN UPDATE products_fts SET title = new.title, brand = new.brand, sku = new.sku, barcode = new.barcode, category = new.category WHERE id = new.id; END

objects.name: trg_refund_requires_dedup
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_refund_requires_dedup BEFORE INSERT ON transactions WHEN NEW.is_refund = 1 AND COALESCE(NEW.sync_status, '') <> 'synced' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_dedup WHERE refund_id = NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'REFUND_BYPASS: refunds must go through refund_sale_atomic'); END

objects.name: order_items

objects.name: orders
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW orders AS SELECT * FROM transactions

objects.name: v_inventory_valuation
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW v_inventory_valuation AS SELECT COUNT(*) as total_skus, COALESCE(SUM(stock),0) as total_units, COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(stock * cost_price)) AS INTEGER),0) as total_cost_value, COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(stock * price)) AS INTEGER),0) as total_retail_value, COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(stock * (price - cost_price))) AS INTEGER),0) as potential_profit_margin FROM products WHERE stock > 0
